about_the_game:
Bunny Roulette demo drops you into a twisted Russian Roulette horror experience for 2-4 players or solo vs AI. Take your seat at the table where every decision could be your last. With a brand-new card ability system, each round becomes a deadly chance of strategy and survival. Outsmart your opponents and pray the chamber is not live. Choose to fire the weapon at yourself or an enemy, pick your ability card and pray for luck.

Bunny Roulette Demo Information

The demo includes tabletop gameplay with ability cards that appear at round two. The demo features all content in the base game; however, it is limited to one tabletop game before locking the menus after completing three rounds.

Cards appear at round 2 in the demo

The card system becomes active at round 2 in the demo offering unparalleled gameplay and strategy that adds a twist to the classic russian roulette gameplay.

The demo offers the complete Bunny Roulette core experience, including 2-4 player multiplayer and the card ability system that appears at round 2. However, rematches are disabled in the demo as it's just a taste of the full game experience available in the full release.

Try your luck in the demo; every round is unique with a revolver chambered with a random assortment of live and dummy rounds. In the demo, you can try and experience 3 unpredictable rounds with a revolver loaded with random live and dummy rounds.

Ability Cards In The Demo

  • Healing card heals you for one life

  • Airshot fires a shot into the air

  • Revolver spin reshuffles the chamber 

Voice chat and unique cards like Healing and Revolver Spin are included in the demo, just as in the full game

Play Solo Or Co-Op With Friends In The Demo

Test your luck at the table with classic Russian roulette gameplay featuring unique cards that introduce novel gameplay and strategy. Cards appear in the second round.

Demo Key Features

  • Take turns in the demo firing a revolver pistol at the table

  • Unique cards available in the demo that can change the course of the battle, appearing at round 2

  • Voice chat in demo for added laughs

  • Play The Demo Online Or VS AI

  • Healing card / Airshot card / Revolver spin card are available in the demo

Unpredictable Rounds In The Bunny Roulette Demo:

Every round is unique, with a revolver chambered with a random assortment of live and dummy rounds. Strategy and luck are both your allies, as no two rounds will ever play out the same way.

Tabletop Multiplayer Experience With Up To 4 Friends:

Bunny Roulette demo supports lobbies of up to four players, and you can also play solo with a play vs AI game mode.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains violent gameplay, bunnies can inflict damage with revolver pistol when aimed at self very dangerous.  Contains killing of bunnies and suicide themes.  Frequent Violence and General Mature Content.
